title: Look Away, Choose the Good
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
King David was a good, good king
Who loved the Lord so well.
But then he saw what wasn't his,
And wanted it, and fell.

[Chorus]
When wrong things come, just look away,
And choose what's good and true.
For God sees all, both night and day,
And He will help you through.

[Verse 2]
He kept on thinking wrong, wrong thoughts,
And bad choice followed bad.
He tried to hide it, but the Lord
Saw all, and He was sad.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
Tomorrow's a new start.
Heavenly Father's watching you
With love inside His heart.

[Chorus]
mood: Hush music. A low, slow rocking pulse holds under the voice like a lap that stays steady while a hard truth is told gently, never sharp, so the child feels safe hearing that even a good king can fall. The chorus lifts with quiet reassurance, like a hand turning a small face back toward the light. By the last verse the rocking grows lower and slower, easing into rest.
